title.value: Building a blazing fast application with Gatsby.js

summary.value:
Overview how Gtabsy source plugin is building the websites, it's speed benefits. And how JamStack in combination with headless CMS can help you to build blazing fast, secure and highly available site. Esp in combination withe Kentico Cloud (now Kontent.ai) headless CMS.

Presented on Kentico Connection (Brno) 2019.

content.value:
The Gatsby source plugin plays a crucial role in building websites by enabling seamless integration between Gatsby.js and various data sources, such as headless CMS platforms. This plugin efficiently fetches data during the build process, allowing developers to pre-render static pages that are highly optimized for speed. By leveraging this approach, websites can deliver exceptional performance, as the static content is served directly from a Content Delivery Network (CDN), reducing load times significantly.

The combination of JamStack architecture and a headless CMS further enhances the capabilities of modern web development. JamStack focuses on pre-rendering and decoupling the frontend from the backend, which not only improves speed but also enhances security by minimizing server-side vulnerabilities. A headless CMS, such as Kontent.ai, acts as a content repository that provides structured data via APIs. This enables developers to build blazing fast, secure, and highly available websites that are easy to scale and maintain.

For more information about the Gtabs ysource plugin and how it connects Gatsby.js with headless CMS solutions, visit the official GitHub repository: https://github.com/kontent-ai/gatsby-packages.
